name: AscendOS — Wistia VSL Stats Daily Sync

nodes.name: VSL video IDs to poll (edit me)
nodes.notes: REQUIRED SETUP: replace the placeholder list below with the real Wistia video IDs you want synced — one output item per video ID. wistia_video_id must exactly match the value already stored on that VSL's row in AscendOS (public.vsls.wistia_video_id) or the push step at the end of this workflow will be rejected with a 404, on purpose — AscendOS will not create a VSL record from this data, only attach a snapshot to one that already exists.

nodes.name: GET Wistia video stats
nodes.notes: REQUIRED SETUP: create an n8n credential (Header Auth) named 'Wistia API Token' with header name 'Authorization' and value 'Bearer <your Wistia API token>', then select it below. Response field names here (stats.play_count, stats.load_count, stats.hours_watched, stats.visitors, stats.engagement) are Wistia's Stats API v1 shape as documented publicly — verify them against a real response from your own Wistia account before trusting the mapping in the next node, Wistia's API has changed field names across versions before.

nodes.name: Map to AscendOS ingest payload
nodes.notes: Builds the exact { event_type, data } shape AscendOS's /api/public/ingest/{token} route expects for event_type 'vsl_metric_snapshot' (src/routes/api/public/ingest.$token.ts). Field names on the AscendOS side (total_plays, unique_viewers, play_rate, avg_percent_watched, page_loads) are real columns on public.vsl_metric_snapshots — adjust the LEFT side of each mapping below only if you confirm Wistia's actual response uses different field names than assumed.

nodes.name: POST to AscendOS ingest endpoint
nodes.notes: REQUIRED SETUP: in AscendOS, open Settings → Connections as an admin, copy the 'Ingest endpoint' URL shown there (it already contains your org's real token: https://<your-ascendos-domain>/api/public/ingest/<token>) and paste the FULL URL below. That page can also rotate the token if it's ever exposed — rotating it will require updating this URL too.
